comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Debug evidence: npm run test failed only in packages/core/test/persistence.test.ts with exports SCHEMA_VERSION 10 expecting 10 but receiving 11. Reproduction is deterministic from the full suite output. Recent change point is intentional SCHEMA_VERSION bump from 10 to 11 for the new turn_failure_diagnostic migration; nearby persistence tests already compare against String(SCHEMA_VERSION), while this one hard-codes the old numeric version. Root cause: stale test literal, not schema runtime behavior.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Debug evidence: second npm run test failed only in packages/core/test/checkpoint.restore.test.ts with a 5000ms timeout in a Dolt-gated restore test. This matches existing bd memory dolt-checkpoint-tests-flaky-under-parallel-load. Reproduction check: npx vitest run packages/core/test/checkpoint.restore.test.ts -t " refuses to restore onto an existing destination\ passed in isolation (1 passed, 4 skipped). Root cause: known full-suite parallel Dolt timeout flake, not this branch.
